topics.title: Import advance payment limit (per transaction)
topics.tags: import importer advance payment limit supplier

values.text: USD 5,000 per import transaction (a limit unchanged for many years).

topics.title: Bank fees when buying foreign exchange
topics.tags: fee fees charges cap 4% import service cash notes

values.text: No 4% ceiling yet. Banks set their own FX fees and structures varied.
All bank fees for buying FX (imports, services, cash notes) capped at 4% in total. Banks must publish FX fees on NBE's website from June 2025.

topics.title: FX allowance for travelers
topics.tags: travel traveler personal business cash card allowance

values.text: Personal travel up to USD 10,000; business travel up to USD 15,000.

topics.title: Advance payment for medical and education abroad
topics.tags: medical education tuition advance payment visa ticket usd 20,000

values.text: Visa and ticket documents were required before a bank could pay.
Banks may pay up to USD 20,000 in advance on a proof-of-payment request or letter, with no visa or ticket requirement (Directive FXD/04/2026).

topics.title: Letters of credit and Cash Against Documents: who approves
topics.tags: letter of credit lc cad approval import bank nbe

values.text: Prior NBE approval was needed, in addition to the bank, to open an LC or process Cash Against Documents.
Banks can approve selected LC and CAD transactions without prior NBE approval (Directive FXD/05/2026).

topics.title: Letter of credit fees
topics.tags: letter of credit lc fees charges annualised pro rata tenor

values.text: LC fee structures varied between banks and were not pro-rated by tenor.
LC fees must be annualised and applied pro rata by tenor, and cannot exceed the maximum NBE set earlier.
